title: Natural Gas, Propane and Electric Rates on the Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
Community-distributed energy is billed on the Utility Pass-Through Service only on the schedule that submeters it. The rates below are the energy figures of every schedule.

## Rate sheet

| Service schedule | Gas base charge (USD per period) | Gas rate (USD per ccf) | Propane base charge (USD per period) | Propane rate (USD per gallon) | Electric customer charge (USD per period) | Electric first-tier bound (kWh) | Electric first-tier rate (USD per kWh) | Electric second-tier rate (USD per kWh) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Water Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule | 12.50 | 1.182 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | 6.00 | 3.149 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 11.25 | 1000 | 0.1284 | 0.1497 |

## Definitions

- **Gas base charge**: the fixed monthly gas meter charge where natural gas is submetered. **Gas rate**: USD per hundred cubic feet (ccf).
- **Propane base charge**: the fixed monthly propane meter charge where propane is submetered. **Propane rate**: USD per gallon, as converted from the vapor meter reading.
- **Electric customer charge**: the fixed monthly electric customer charge where electricity is submetered.
- **Electric first-tier bound**: the upper bound of the first electric energy tier, kWh per billing period. The **first-tier rate** applies within the first tier and the **second-tier rate** above it.

## Quick reading

**Single-service sheet:** each column has figures on one schedule only — natural gas on the Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule, propane on the Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule, electricity on the Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule.

**Electric tiers (illustration, hypothetical use):** with a first-tier bound of 1000 kWh, a period of 1,240 kWh has 1000 kWh in the first tier at 0.1284 USD and 240 kWh in the second tier at 0.1497 USD; a period of 860 kWh lies entirely in the first tier.
